name: Generate Convex Key
description: Generate a new Ed25519 key pair and store its seed encrypted in the caller's secret store. The seed is never returned. Refuses to replace an existing secret unless overwrite is explicitly true.

name.description: Name for the encrypted seed in the caller's secret store, for example CONVEX_SIGNER

overwrite.description: Set true to replace an existing secret. Omitted or false protects the existing key.

secret.description: Secret reference containing the seed, for example s/CONVEX_SIGNER

accountKey.description: Public Ed25519 account key as a 32-byte Convex hex blob
